appStore.name: Fridge Pulse
appStore.subtitle: Use food before it expires
appStore.promotionalText: Snap a photo of your fridge, see what needs eating first, and get meal ideas that use it up. Try free for 2 weeks.
appStore.description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about.

Fridge Pulse turns a quick photo of your fridge, freezer or pantry into a simple list of what you have and when it needs eating. It reminds you before things go off and suggests meals that use up the most urgent ingredients first.

HOW IT WORKS
- Snap a photo of a shelf. Fridge Pulse spots the food and reads printed dates when it can.
- Something unfamiliar? Fridge Pulse searches the web for the exact product and shows you a picture to confirm, then remembers it next time.
- Check the list, fix anything that looks off, and save. You are always in control.
- Your Pulse home screen shows what needs using first, colour-coded by how soon it expires.
- Get a gentle reminder the day before food expires.
- Get meal ideas built around what is about to go, with your diet and servings in mind.

MADE FOR REAL KITCHENS
- Works for the fridge, freezer and pantry.
- Add items by hand any time.
- See how much food you rescue instead of binning.
- Your food list stays on your phone. No account needed.
- No ads.

FREE FOR 2 WEEKS, THEN $9.99 PER MONTH
Try everything free for 2 weeks. After that, Fridge Pulse is $9.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings.

A NOTE ON FOOD SAFETY
Dates are estimates and photo scanning can make mistakes. Always check the packaging and use your own judgement. When in doubt, throw it out.

PRIVACY
Photos and ingredient lists are sent to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) only if you agree, and Fridge Pulse does not keep your photos.
